# netbox_owner_group (Data Source)

Requires NetBox v4.5.0 or newer. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_owner_group" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the owner group. At least one of `name` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the owner group.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
